agent_priors_used: General prior (not SPIDER evidence): a treatment can only demonstrate value against a comparator that is not already at the success ceiling; a ceiling-bound comparator yields a non-identifying experiment and is a design defect, not a product null.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): when a prerequisite keeps being re-discovered as a failure across several packets of one lane, it should be repaired once in the owning substrate/product lane rather than re-measured; repeated preregistration of the same absent prerequisite is wasted intelligence.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): a durable, promoted, shipped capability is higher leverage than refining the measurement scope of a claim that is already bounded-VALIDATED; shipping converts research into product.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): same-model benchmark comparisons are only meaningful if the selected runtime can actually execute the minimal task; endpoint capability is a hard prerequisite, not part of the benchmark estimate.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): deeply concentrated single-claim trajectories exhibit diminishing marginal information and path dependence, so a continuation should carry an explicit bounded-park condition rather than an open-ended loop.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): server-side access control (rate limits, challenge pages, transport resets) is environment dynamics separable from agent policy, so it is a legitimate physics observable rather than a policy artifact.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): discovery channels (robots/sitemaps/feeds/structured data) can collapse apparent graph depth, so a hop distance measured by link-following BFS may overstate the true acquisition cost barrier.

allocation.comparative_reasoning: Considered assigning Product the non-degenerate task bank (B2) or first-party C-PRODUCT-ECON economics (h(N), Cwrite, Cmiss). The task bank is assigned to Runtime because it is a measurement/execution substrate question and Product's carrier is the higher-priority blocker; splitting Product across carrier and bank would under-serve blocker (1). First-party economics is downstream: measuring h(N)/Cwrite/Cmiss is only meaningful once a shipped treatment and a variable-success bank exist, and the audit places it at priority #5. Considered running the C-LLM-INHERIT four-arm benchmark now: explicitly rejected because ALL THREE readiness conditions fail (no shipped carrier, no dynamic-range bank, no capable endpoint); funding it would reproduce the design-compromised packet class. Considered PARK: wrong because the lane is idle and the carrier is the single most central unresolved product dependency.

allocation.question: Can the audited parameterized-inheritance capability be made DURABLE and PROMOTABLE in the shipping kernel path (src/spider) -- a pre-freeze arm-differentiation certificate showing that the SHIPPED kernel executes an inherited parameterized mechanism (known-positive: induction observation -> parameterized distillation -> resolve to EXECUTABLE with a correctly bound, non-null action -> execute against the fixture -> verify) AND refuses a known-negative binding (missing-parameter / out-of-support / wrong-intent) with a recorded reason and a null action, with unit tests, an accounting check that the inherited-path counters increment, and the kernel identity bound at freeze -- so that the carrier actually lands in main through the pinned Product promotion path without manually copying experiment code?
allocation.rationale: Readiness condition (1) for the real-agent benchmark is unmet, and it is the highest-leverage blocker in the program. The strongest accepted C-PARAM-INHERIT packets (EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064 live parameterized path on a real credential-free substrate, audit PASS; EXP-PRODUCT-37950607128 arm-differentiation certificate, audit PASS) prove the mechanism can be live and causally attributable, but NONE has promote_to_product=true and src/spider/kernel.py still exposes only literal distill() at confidence 0.5 with no distill_parameterized(). Product is IDLE after EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440 (REVISE). The audit's priority #1 is to land the audited carrier in the shipped kernel through promotion, and B1 is stated as the highest-leverage open blocker. REOPEN is the right action because the lane must resume a previously active capability direction (C-PARAM-INHERIT) that was left incomplete; the scientific objective is unchanged from the carrier line but materially different from the lane's last-parent handoff, which proposed running the four-arm benchmark now.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: SPIDER has 431 canonical experiments and a sharp but unfinished causal chain: observe -> parameterized mechanism -> executable binding in the SHIPPED treatment -> applicability/freshness decision -> real external-agent action -> lower end-to-end cost per successful partially novel task. The program has NOT yet shipped the audited parameterized carrier and has NOT yet run a non-degenerate real-agent benchmark. Effective epistemic state: C-MEAS-VALID VALIDATED (bounded, authorship-separated real-Chromium scope); C-PARAM-INHERIT EXPERIMENTAL (live, causally attributable distill->resolve->execute on a real credential-free substrate, audit PASS, but the frozen margin was unreachable because cold and retrieval both sat at success=1.0 and the treatment was bounded at 0.80 by conservative support inference); C-FRESHNESS EXPERIMENTAL (extraction defect confirmed on 4 pinned anchors, but the PART II D1V value-only-rotation population was degenerate since all 6 trials came from one anchor); C-DELTA-REPAIR EXPERIMENTAL (only a bounded single-node positive survives); C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY EXPERIMENTAL (the two most recent Product packets are a bounded substrate-class negative: the deterministic REST cold/retrieval comparators stay at the 1.0 ceiling, so the cost/novelty test is non-identifying); C-LLM-INHERIT HYPOTHESIS (the four-arm benchmark is design-compromised: the two credential-free endpoints cannot drive the minimal multi-step Web task); C-PRODUCT-ECON HYPOTHESIS (bounded negative about one external artifact; first-party h(N), Cwrite, Cmiss never measured); C-WEB-DYNAMICS HYPOTHESIS (strong bounded negative: value-level predictability prevalence 0.043 on the frozen credential-free HTTP action-gating substrate); C-CROSSSITE HYPOTHESIS (no true website-holdout result); C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE HYPOTHESIS (audit: no live end-to-end path justifies reopening as an isolated micro-benchmark). The binding constraint on the whole program is readiness, not activity: ALL THREE benchmark readiness conditions fail in current accepted evidence. (1) The shipped treatment carrier is missing: the main kernel still exposes literal distill() at confidence 0.5 and no distill_parameterized(), and NO canonical product packet has promote_to_product=true (verified across all 431 index entries); Product is IDLE. (2) The task bank has no dynamic range: the deterministic credential-free REST class gives cold and retrieval ceiling success, and this same failure has now been re-discovered in multiple Product packets (EXP-PRODUCT-37982016598, EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440) rather than repaired once. (3) No credential-free endpoint or local model can drive the minimal multi-step Web-agent task (Intel EXP-INTEL-37973264582 Gate 2 FAIL). Therefore this cycle funds NO full four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON execution, and instead directs the two idle lanes at exactly two of those blockers and preserves the four in-flight transactions. Allocation: Product -> REOPEN C-PARAM-INHERIT to build and promote the durable carrier (blocker 1); Runtime -> PIVOT C-MEAS-VALID to build and measurement-validly certify a non-ceiling discovery-requiring task substrate (blocker 2); Intel -> CONTINUE its frozen credential-free model-capability packet (blocker 3); Graph -> CONTINUE the bounded C-FRESHNESS D1V multi-anchor test (safety decision, audit-endorsed conditional); Physics -> CONTINUE the bounded C-WEB-DYNAMICS access-barrier onset/recovery test (materially new observable, audit-endorsed); Frontier -> CONTINUE the frozen site-native-discovery packet (tests whether depth cost is real before treating path persistence as an optimization target). This concentrates new work on the three prerequisites a real-agent benchmark actually needs rather than producing another measurement-invalid benchmark packet.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The Scout ran in DEGRADED SCOUT MODE (scout model unavailable, rc=124): no external reconnaissance, no external baselines, no cross-lane dependency synthesis, and empty spider_evidence. Its brief is therefore staff advice only and was not treated as authoritative or as a prerequisite. Its candidate_directions essentially reproduced the already-active in-flight mandates (frontier site-native discovery; intel credential-free model capability; graph C-FRESHNESS D1V multi-anchor; physics access barriers; product/runtime blocker removal), so it did NOT change the strategic direction of this cycle. What it did contribute is a liveness cross-check: it independently flagged graph and physics as PREFREEZE and runtime and product as IDLE, which matches the machine snapshot and confirmed that the two idle lanes required explicit reactivation. I did not use the degraded brief to justify the Product/Runtime reactivations; those were derived from the Codex effective claim state and the independent program audit (shipped carrier missing in src/spider/kernel.py; no promote_to_product=true; task-bank dynamic-range certificate unsatisfiable). I did not authorize any broad external search this cycle; the only external-reconnaissance value at stake (an alternative capable credential-free endpoint) is already inside Intel's frozen packet, so I left it there rather than opening a new Intel thread.
